activity.notes: After an out-of-office interval, Getúlio Vargas returned to Brazil’s presidency by election, taking office on 31 January 1951 and serving until his death on 24 August 1954. This is a distinct Activity from his 1930–1945 rule.

sources.title: ‘À sanha dos meus inimigos, o legado de minha morte’
sources.citation_text: FGV CPDOC records Vargas’s return to power on 31 January 1951 and the end of his second government with his death on 24 August 1954.

sources.title: 4ª República (18.09.1946 - 09.04.1964)
sources.citation_text: Brazil’s Chamber of Deputies records Vargas taking office on 31 January 1951 and the vice president assuming after Vargas’s death on 24 August 1954.
